# ex: match with struct-typed wildcard
ex {
	var s S
	F(s) -> G(s)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type S struct{ X, Y int }

func F(s S) int { return s.X + s.Y }
func G(s S) int { return s.X * s.Y }

func H() int {
	return F(S{1, 2})
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -6,5 +6,5 @@
 func G(s S) int { return s.X * s.Y }

 func H() int {
-	return F(S{1, 2})
+	return G(S{1, 2})
 }
